name: Magic Trackpad
author: Drew Purdy
description: Trackpad status and gestures in the Omarchy bar. Level 1: read and set the libinput touchpad behaviour Hyprland already supports — tap-to-click, two-finger right-click, natural scroll, scroll speed, disable-while-typing — plus finger-swipe gestures, all persisted and reversible. Later phases add Apple Magic Trackpad Taptic Engine strength and a custom-gesture daemon.

barWidget.description: Touchpad behaviour and finger-swipe gestures, from the bar.
